appFullName.description: Full extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and the toolbar tooltip.

appShortName.description: Short product name used under the toolbar icon (max 12 chars recommended).

appDescription.message: Select YouTube videos and Shorts, then copy clean watch URLs for NotebookLM, AI notes, and research.

appName.description: Wordmark shown as the popup heading.

statusChecking.description: Status pill while the popup checks the active tab.

statusReady.description: Status pill when the active tab is YouTube and TubeLM is operating.

statusNotYouTube.description: Status pill when the active tab is not a YouTube page.

statusUnreachable.description: Status pill when the content script cannot be reached.

labelSelected.description: Label above the selection count in the metric card.

noteEmpty.message: Tick videos on the page, or use Select visible to add a row at a time.
noteEmpty.description: Helper note inside the metric card when no videos are selected.

noteReady.message: Ready to copy clean watch and Shorts URLs.
noteReady.description: Helper note inside the metric card when at least one video is selected.

noteOpenYouTube.message: Open youtube.com, then pick videos right from the page.
noteOpenYouTube.description: Helper note when the active tab is not on YouTube.

noteUnreachable.message: Reload the YouTube tab and try again.
noteUnreachable.description: Helper note when TubeLM cannot reach the content script.

copyLabelEmpty.description: Primary button label when nothing is selected.

copyLabelCount.description: Primary button label when at least one video is selected.

selectVisibleButton.description: Secondary action button that selects all videos visible in the current viewport.

clearButton.description: Secondary action button that clears the current selection.

thanksLine.description: Friendly thank-you line above the credits row.

creditsPrefix.description: Word that precedes the author name in the credits row.

linkGitHub.description: Label of the GitHub repository link in the credits row.

copied.description: Confirmation shown briefly inside the primary button after a successful copy.
